posts.topic_title: A new laser to add to the family...
posts.author: Jem
posts.post_subject: A new laser to add to the family...
posts.content_md:
Hi All

I picked up this little Argon Ion (very cheaply) on Ebay recently...

![DSC03873.JPG](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=6045)

![DSC03872.JPG](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=6044)

It's like new condition and outputting a very steady 20.5mW. I didn't buy it to do holography, It was just to add to my vintage lasers collection 

I just wanted to know if anyone has used one of these for holography with any degree of success. I don't want to buy any plates without having any idea as to whether it's useful or not.

I guess I could always combine it with my ageing HeNe and my C315m (with power turned down). I'd then have a nice little white light system... Hmmm... Now there's a thought... now where can I get some panchromatic plates? 

Cheers

Jem

That looks nice Bernard. We ought to do a swap as mine is 110v and the UK supply is 240v

If anyone in the UK has a nice whitelight gas laser in 'as new' condition they want to offload, just send me a PM

posts.post_subject: A new laser to add to the family...
posts.content_md:
Nice job Jem,

Isn't the coherrence length on air cooled systems pretty small. I don't recall that they even came with an etalon, but I could be wrong.

Argons are about 5 GHz linewidth; HeNe is 1 GHz so coherence is less.

Good luck

Tony

posts.author: Jem
posts.post_subject: A new laser to add to the family...
posts.content_md:
Hi Tony

There's definately no Etalon fitted on this unit. When I get the time i'll check the coherence length but I suspect you're correct in that it will be pretty poor. No matter though, it's a nice little laser that didn't cost too much money and it looks good in my erm... 'Collection' 

Cheers

Jem
